answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique Grad-Shafranov equilibrium signature, so a sybil must solve a distinct toroidal boundary-value problem whose cost scales with grid resolution. Just as a pigment marks a sparrow while jade stays invariant, this equilibrium fingerprint is cheap to verify but costly to forge, and neoclassical island-suppression tolerances. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
